Whatamoon looks an interesting debutant, half-sister to Juan Elcano.

His win at Musselburgh came over 2m but the drop back to this trip shouldn't prove too problematic and he can extend the recent purple patch. Saligo Bay poses the most obvious threat having got back in the winner's enclosure last time when dropped back to 1m2f after failing to fire for much of last season over 1m6f-2m. This trip suits and he's pretty versatile ground-wise. He should be in the shake-up. Unplugged is interesting having fallen to a threatening mark now he's hinted at a return to form with a decent pipe-opener last time. If he can build on that he will prove a force here, even if he might prefer conditions a bit quicker

selections.comment: PIETRO is interesting back on turf after a couple of decent efforts at Kempton (7f and 1m) to kick off this campaign. From a pound lower now and with conditions looking set fair for a bold bid he should go very close. Jarham stands out on handicap debut. Clive Cox's gelding was well supported in the market when runner-up stepped up to 7f at Kempton when last seen in December and showed enouth there, and in a soft ground maiden at Doncaster prior to that, to suggest a mark of 74 to be on the lenient side. If wound up for this return he should make his presence felt in a tight affair, while Think Of A Name demonstrated his well-being with an encouraging 3rd on season debut last time on ground that was a bit lively. He can make a bold bid and is a threat to all if his stamina holds. An improved effort from Chilly Breeze looks on the cards back on turf and he could go well

selections.comment: PARTICIPLE can make a winning return having made a striking debut when just touched off by a future Listed winner. Prospects look bright for Ralph Beckett's Frankel filly and she should prove well up to this before going on to much loftier targets. Mister Winston, back over a mile after flattening out over 1m2f at Chester, could prove dangerous from the front and looks the biggest threat to upsetting the applecart for the selction. Fan Club was eye-catching on debut flying home late over 7f and is feared but Influential is next best having shown good promise on debut and he can make the frame. Newcomers Forest Caper, a valuable purchase, and Carmicheal, form the Haggas yard, need a check in the market but their task looks a stiff one on debut

He was 4th of 12 in deep ground the only time he's raced on turf, on career debut, and should handle conditions. The list of dangers is long, including Harpsichord, steadily progressive and perched on a workable opening mark, Is I Right, a comfortable course and sitance winner last time, Atlantic Sunset, knocking on the door and Best Adventure, improved for the step up to 1m2f last time and with plenty of scope for improvement beyond it. The latter pair look best equipped to hit the frame
